title: Assistant Manager - Advertising Solutions
jobDescription:

By combining Marketplace and Impact advertisements, we empower brands to engage with high-intent travelers at the right moment, in the right context, and with the right message. With Make My Trip’s high-value audience in strong demand, Ad Tech plays a pivotal role in driving impact for advertisers while unlocking meaningful monetization opportunities for the platform. What will you be doing: Manage full execution of display advertising campaigns, including campaign setup, monitoring, optimization, and reporting. Monitor campaign delivery, pacing, and performance to ensure advertiser commitments and revenue targets are met. Own display inventory planning and utilization, working closely with Sales on campaign feasibility and inventory allocation. title: Associate Product Manager (Corporate)
jobDescription:
ROLE:
Product Management Level: RL 3/RL 4 Reporting To: AD
- Product Manager Location: Gurugram About the Function: The Product Management function at Make My Trip sits at the core of how we build, scale, and reimagine travel. By bringing together technology, data, design, and business insight, it creates seamless experiences for millions of travelers across discovery, personalization, payments, and loyalty. Our PM teams act as mini-CEOs — shaping strategy, translating insights into impact, and pushing the boundaries of travel tech to make MMT a truly product-first organization. Within this, my Biz — Make My Trip's comprehensive business travel suite — is redefining how organizations manage corporate travel end to end. The Post Sales charter focuses on everything that happens after a booking is made: servicing, support, modifications, and issue resolution, ensuring corporate travelers and travel admins get a fast, reliable, and delightful experience at every step. About the

ROLE:
The Product Manager role for my Biz Post Sales is centered around building high-impact, AI-led solutions that transform how corporate travelers are serviced after booking. The incumbent will own the Voice Bot and conversational AI experience within the post-sales journey — driving automation, deflection, and quality across customer interactions. A core focus of this role is leveraging AI to power the Voice Bot, systematically measuring and improving its quality through evaluation frameworks (Evals) and customer frustration scoring, and continuously expanding the range of use cases the bot can resolve autonomously. A key success metric is measuring actual agent handoff and consistently reducing it through smarter, higher-quality automation. This role demands a strong product mindset, comfort with AI/ML-driven products and data, and close collaboration with business, tech, design, and analytics teams. The Product Manager will be expected to deeply understand post-sales pain points, prioritize impactful initiatives, and deliver outcomes that improve customer experience and operational efficiency for my Biz . What you'll be doing: Owning the AI-powered Voice Bot roadmap for the my Biz post-sales journey — conceptualizing and building accurate , scalable, and impactful conversational experiences that resolve customer needs autonomously. Defining and driving the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-led servicing to deliver measurable improvements in automation, deflection, and customer satisfaction. Building and operationalizing Evals (evaluation frameworks) to measure Voice Bot quality, accuracy, and reliability, and driving consistent quality improvements based on these signals. Defining, measuring, and improving customer frustration scores across bot interactions, and using these insights to refine flows and responses. Measuring actual agent handoff rates and driving initiatives to systematically reduce handoffs through higher-quality automation and expanded coverage. Continuously identifying and adding new post-sales use cases for the Voice Bot to handle, expanding automation coverage while maintaining quality. Collaborating closely with technology, design, QA, supply, finance, AI/ML, and customer support teams to ensure seamless execution of product releases. Owning and tracking key product KPIs, analyzing performance continuously, and iterating post-launch to strengthen adoption and experience. Building strong product insights through consistent customer engagement, conversation analysis, market research, and competitive benchmarking. Creating a seamless and differentiated service experience for corporate travelers and travel admins within the my Biz ecosystem. Demonstrating a passion for data, problem-solving, and simplifying complex experiences to deliver intuitive, high-impact solutions. Qualification & Experience Management graduate from a reputed institute with 1-3 years of experience in a consumer-facing, technology-enabled business or product environment. Exposure to AI/ML-driven products, conversational AI, or automation is strongly preferred. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Key Success Factors for the Role Customer Centricity: A deep passion for understanding and improving customer and partner experiences. Ownership & Execution: Ability to translate ideas into impactful products through structured execution and cross-functional collaboration. Strategic Thinking: Aptitude for building long-term product vision aligned with business goals. Analytical Rigor: Data-driven approach to problem-solving and decision-making, especially around Evals, quality metrics, and handoff reduction. Innovation & Agility: Eagerness to experiment with AI, learn quickly, and adapt solutions to dynamic market needs. Communication & Influence: Strong ability to articulate product vision and rally teams around shared outcomes. About Us: Nurtured from the seed of a single idea 'to empower the traveller with easy & instant travel bookings providing comprehensive choices', Make My Trip is a pioneer in India's online travel space. Founded by Deep Kalra in the year 2000, Make My Trip began its journey by serving the US-India travel market with best-value products & services, powered by robust technology and round-the-clock customer support. After successfully consolidating its position as a customer-first brand, known for its reliability and transparency, Make My Trip launched its India operations in
2005. Over the years, we have partnered with many leading brands from the aviation & hospitality industries. What makes our story even stronger is the performance of our newly launched segments, like my Biz — our comprehensive business travel suite — and my Partner , an exclusive platform for travel agents.

title: Product Analyst (Ground Transport)
jobDescription:
ROLE:
Product Analyst Level: RL2/3 Location: Bangalore Reporting to: Director
- Product Management About the function: Ground Transport is one of the fastest growing businesses at Make My Trip, serving millions of travellers across Bus, Rail and Cab journeys. The business plays a critical role in expanding travel accessibility across India, particularly in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities, while delivering seamless, affordable and reliable mobility experiences. As travel behaviours evolve, Ground Transport is reimagining the booking and travel experience enabled with AI-first product innovation. From personalized recommendations to conversational booking journeys, automated customer assistance and real-time decision systems, we are building the next generation of travel experiences at scale. The Ground Transport team combines deep consumer understanding, data-driven decision making and cutting-edge technology to solve complex traveller problems across the entire journey lifecycle. Product managers, business leaders, engineers, designers and data scientists work together to build experiences that delight customers and drive meaningful business outcomes. About the

ROLE:
We are looking for a data-driven Product Analyst to join the Ground Transport team. In this role, you will convert product and user journey data into clear insights that help Product Managers validate decisions, measure launches, and shape the roadmap. The Product Analyst will help the business make better product decisions through data, experimentation, and scalable insight systems. This role will own product performance tracking, support discovery and launch analysis, and build AI-enabled workflows and self-serve analytics tools that reduce dependency on manual requests. The analyst will partner with Product, Data, and Technology teams to turn product questions into trusted metrics, dashboards, and actionable recommendations. What you'll be doing: Build AI-enabled tooling and self-serve workflows Id entify recurring manual analysis requests and convert them into dashboards, templates, automated reports, or AI-assisted workflows. Use AI tools to accelerate insight generation, anomaly detection, workflow documentation, and stakeholder-ready summaries. Partner with data science, product, and technology teams to build a self-serve platform that lets stakeholders answer common product questions independently. Maintain metric definitions, reusable query logic, and documentation so self-serve outputs remain trusted and consistent. Support product discovery and experimentation Partner with Product Managers to frame hypotheses, size opportunities, and evaluate product ideas using data. Design and analyze experiments, A/B tests, cohort cuts, and pre/post launch reads to guide roadmap decisions. Create clear readouts that connect analysis to customer impact, business impact, and next actions. Bridge product, data, and technology teams Translate business and product questions into clear analytical requirements, tracking needs, and data definitions. Collaborate with engineering and data teams to improve event instrumentation, reporting reliability, and analytical coverage. Create structured product insights for leadership reviews, roadmap discussions, and launch retrospectives. Drive product performance visibility Define success metrics for product launches, feature adoption, funnel movement, engagement, conversion, and retention. Build dashboards and insight narratives that help product and leadership teams understand what is working, what is not, and where to focus next. Identify trends, anomalies, and user journey friction from product data, then translate findings into practical recommendations. Qualification & Experience: 1-3 years of experience in product analytics, business analytics, data analytics, BI, or a related product-facing role. Strong SQL and Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar visualization tools. Comfort with product metrics, funnels, cohorts, experiments, and translating analysis into clear business recommendations. Exposure to AI tools, workflow automation, no-code or low-code tools, Python, or analytics engineering is a plus. Strong communication skills and the ability to work with Product, Data, Engineering, Growth, and business stakeholders. Key success factors for the

ROLE:
Success in this role means turning product and user data into clear insights that improve roadmap decisions, feature performance, and customer journeys. The Product Analyst should build trusted dashboards, metrics, and AI-enabled self-serve workflows, while collaborating with the Data Science team on analysis, experimentation, and insight generation. Strong partnership with Product, Data, Technology, and Data Science teams will be key to translating business questions into scalable analytics solutions.

title: Business Development Manager
jobDescription:
ROLE:
MICE
- Operations Level: Deputy Manager Reporting To: Vice President
- Corporate Channel Location: Mumbai About the Function: Make My Trip’s Corporate Channel business enables organizations to manage their travel and event requirements with efficiency and control. Its flagship product, My Biz, is a self-booking platform designed to simplify business travel—offering real-time bookings, policy compliance, and cost optimization. Today, over 59,000 companies use My Biz to streamline their corporate travel operations. The business also houses a fast-growing MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions) vertical that delivers end-to-end solutions for group travel and events. From offsites and reward programs to large-scale conferences and exhibitions, the MICE team drives seamless execution through a strong supplier network, centralized contracting, and cost-effective planning. Together, My Biz and MICE position Make My Trip as a comprehensive partner for corporate mobility and engagement—empowering organizations to manage both everyday travel and strategic events with equal excellence. About the

ROLE:
The incumbent in this role will be responsible for end-to-end execution of corporate MICE movements (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Exhibitions) across domestic and international destinations. The role demands strong operational control, vendor coordination, financial discipline, crisis handling capability, and seamless on-ground delivery for large corporate groups ranging from 50 to 1000+ pax. This position requires a detail-oriented professional capable of managing multiple high-value accounts while ensuring operational excellence and client satisfaction. What will you be doing: Manage end-to-end execution of MICE movements from post-sales handover to final billing closure. Execute domestic and international corporate events including incentives, conferences, leadership meets, and R&R programs. Prepare detailed operational plans covering travel, stay, transfers, F&B, and event setups. Coordinate with vendors including airlines, hotels, DMCs, transport providers, and event agencies for seamless delivery. Negotiate with vendors to secure cost efficiencies, upgrades, and added value services. Monitor event budgets, track costs, and ensure margin protection as per defined P&L. Validate supplier invoices and coordinate with finance for payments, reconciliations, and billing closure. Manage visa processes and ensure timely documentation and compliance for all travelers. Coordinate closely with clients, share updates, and handle last-minute changes effectively. Travel with groups when required to manage on-ground execution and overall guest experience. Oversee event delivery including check-ins, F&B functions, theme nights, and production setups. Handle operational challenges such as delays, overbookings, or unforeseen disruptions. Develop contingency plans to manage risks and ensure smooth execution in critical situations. Maintain trackers, share status updates, and conduct post-event reviews. Qualification & Experience: Graduate with 6–10 years of experience in contracting, sales, operations, or MICE. Prior exposure to corporate travel, event management, or hospitality will be preferred. Key Success Factors for the

ROLE:
Demonstrating a deep understanding of corporate business development and account management. Engaging with leading industry professionals and clients, building strong relationships and networks. Gaining exposure to data analysis, insights generation, and strategic decision-making. Exploring domestic and international MICE destinations through travel opportunities.

title: Marketing Analytics
jobDescription:
ROLE:
Marketing Analytics Level: Assistant Manager Location: Gurugram Reporting To: Senior Manager
- Marketing Insights and Analytics About the function: The Marketing team at Make My Trip plays a critical role in shaping brand perception, driving customer acquisition, and unlocking growth across our lines of business. The function works across brand marketing, performance marketing, CRM, mobile marketing, and social/digital channels to build high-impact campaigns that strengthen customer engagement and elevate MMT’s presence in the market. Within this ecosystem, the Marketing Insights & Analytics team serves as the strategic backbone that fuels data-led decision-making. The team partners closely with marketing leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to define key performance metrics, set up robust measurement frameworks, and uncover insights that drive performance improvement. From campaign analytics and attribution modeling to customer segmentation and channel optimization, the function plays a pivotal role in shaping marketing strategy, enhancing ROI, and powering innovation through deep data-driven intelligence. About the

ROLE:
The incumbent will be responsible for solving complex marketing and business problems through advanced analytics and data science. The role demands strong proficiency in SQL and Python, along with the ability to design, build, and operationalize statistical or machine learning models that deliver measurable business impact. This position involves translating ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches, conducting deep-dive analyses, and identifying root causes to guide strategic and tactical decision-making. The incumbent will collaborate closely with marketing, product, and business teams to deliver scalable, insights-led solutions that enhance performance, improve customer outcomes, and drive continuous optimization. What will you be doing: Data Analytics & RCA Perform day-to-day analytics on large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights. Conduct deep root cause analyses using statistical methods, hypothesis testing, and time-series/comparative techniques. Build automated data pipelines and workflows using SQL and Python. Data Science & Modeling Design, develop, validate, and deploy statistical models and machine learning algorithms (classification, regression, forecasting, clustering). Build end-to-end data science solutions from problem definition to deployment and ongoing performance monitoring. Collaborate with engineering teams to productionize models and ensure robust tracking. Data Engineering & Reporting Write optimized and scalable SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and data quality processes. Develop reusable analytical frameworks, scripts, and tools in Python. Create clear, automated dashboards and reports to convey insights to stakeholders. Business & Cross-Functional Collaboration Translate business problems into structured analytical approaches in partnership with product, marketing, operations, and leadership teams. Provide data-driven recommendations to support strategy, experimentation (A/B testing), and continuous optimization. Qualification & Experience: Graduate from a reputed institute with 4–6 years of experience in analytics, data science, or consumer insights roles. Strong proficiency in Excel, SQL, and Python for data analysis. Experience using data analytics tools such as Adobe Analytics, Mixpanel, or Google Analytics. Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and analytical rigor. Proven track record of delivering business impact through data-driven insights. Key Success factors of the

ROLE:
Analytical Expertise: Strong command of analytical tools and techniques, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations. Adaptability & Innovation: Comfort with ambiguity and evolving business needs, along with a willingness to explore new methodologies, tools, and approaches. Business & Growth Mindset: Ability to connect analytical outcomes with business objectives, influence decision-making, and unlock growth opportunities. Communication & Stakeholder Management: Effective communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts and build trusted partnerships across cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

Assistant Manager
- Holiday Sales Level: Assistant Manager Reporting To: Associate Director
- Holiday Sales Location: Gurgaon About the Function: With a deep understanding of Indian consumers' travel preferences, the MMT Holidays team curates a wide array of holiday packages for destinations across the globe. As a leading name in the leisure travel space, MMT Holidays serves over 3 lakh travelers annually. Our offerings span both domestic and international markets, covering more than 50 destinations worldwide. With a strong focus on delivering seamless and memorable travel experiences, we have become a trusted choice for holiday packages among Indian travelers. Complementing this is our Holiday Experts (HE) business, a pan-India network of 2000+ trained experts who work closely with customers to craft personalized itineraries and ensure end-to-end support. Together, the Holidays team and Holiday Experts ecosystem form the backbone of Make My Trip’s leisure travel business, committed to redefining the way Indians explore the world. About the

title: Key Account Manager
jobDescription:
ROLE:
Key Account Manager
- Corporate Channel Level: Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager Reporting To: Director / Senior Manager
- Corporate Channel Location: Gurgaon About the Function: My Biz, a corporate travel management platform by Make My Trip, provides a customizable, real-time self-booking system that seamlessly integrates into a company’s structure to deliver convenience, transparency, savings, and the power of choice. Over the last five years, it has onboarded 50,000prominent corporates who are benefiting from the platform’s seamless experience and significant cost savings. What you will be doing: Business Growth & Account Expansion: Focus on driving revenue growth by increasing wallet share across existing large accounts. It includes activating new Lines of Business (LOBs) within client organizations and fostering deeper process integration to position the company as a strategic partner. This approach ensures that client relationships evolve beyond transactional engagements into long-term, value-driven partnerships. Client Delight & Retention: Emphasize seamless servicing and operational excellence across all client touchpoints. It involves building and nurturing multi-level relationships within client organizations to deepen engagement and trust. Additionally, it requires proactive exception management and swift issue resolution to maintain high satisfaction levels and ensure zero client churn. Strategic Client Engagement: Execute through structured, meaningful interactions—such as Quarterly Joint Business Reviews (JBRs)—to align on performance and identify future opportunities. The role involves crafting tailored engagement strategies for each key account to ensure continuous value delivery and alignment with client objectives. These efforts help strengthen trust, uncover growth potential, and reinforce the company’s position as a long-term strategic partner. Leadership & Team Development: Demonstrate strong leadership through people engagement, data-driven decision-making, and a focus on operational excellence. The candidate is expected to mentor and empower the team, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement. A key success factor is effective cross-functional collaboration with the operations, supply, and product teams. Qualification & Experience: Postgraduate from a reputed institute with 5–6 years of relevant experience in Key Account Management, Customer Success, or Strategic Client Engagement. Proven experience in conducting Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs/JBRs) and managing multilevel client relationships while driving customer satisfaction and business growth. title: Lead Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Location: Make My Trip, Bangalore Experience Level: 6-8 years Position: Lead Data Scientist Reimagine Travel decisions with the power of AI @ Make My Trip. Make My Trip has been AI/ML/Data/Platform powered organization. We are now shaping the future of travel for Bharat customers, with Gen AI-centric innovations, leveraging SLMs, Vernacular STT/TTS, and travel content systems. Join us to take these systems, chatbots, Cx, content to next orbit of excellence. About the

ROLE:
As a Lead data scientist , you will: · Design, develop, and fine-tune multilingual Small Language Models (SLMs) with advanced AI capabilities for agentic applications such as travel destination expertise, Myra bot orchestration, hotel semantic search, and customer support bot assistance. · Build custom Natural Language Inference (NLI) and reward-scoring models to improve preference-based SLM training (DPO, PPO, Steer LM etc), enhancing multi-agent response quality and relevance. · Develop and implement active learning pipelines for data and models, for NLP, Named Entity Recognition (NER), conversational latent intent/concepts, travel-specific embeddings, and domain-specific SLM training for summarization, rephrasing, and planning . · Architect and enhance conversational AI systems to dynamically adapt and comprehend concepts/intents, NLP, and NER tasks across multiple lines of business, supporting the Myra chatbot ecosystem. · Drive end-to-end quality assurance through robust integration and experience testing, establishing objective evaluation metrics and leveraging A/B testing for performance optimization. · Mentor and guide engineering teams in advanced SLM and Generative AI analytics , fostering growth and innovation. · Collaborate across teams to deliver scalable solutions that impact millions of users, ensuring alignment with business goals. · Focus on hosting and deploying Generative AI models on robust and efficient infrastructure to support large-scale operations. What You Bring: Deep experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP & NLI), tiny/small language models, base language model retraining (both transformer and BERT based architectures). Extensive experience in conversational NLP systems. Experience in SLM adaptor fine tuning, SFT training, SLM pruning (base and instruct models) Experience in retriever frameworks in Q&A bots. Experience in contrastive learning, graph learning based embedding methods with heterogenous features. Preferably experience in building NLP active learning pipelines. Demonstrable experience in scaling your models to large scale search systems is a plus. Very good critical reasoning skills, data centric NLP/NLI systems. Must have temperament and hunger to work in fast-paced environment. Why Join Us? Be part of a team revolutionizing the travel industry with cutting-edge AI and Generative AI technologies, impacting millions of users worldwide.
